newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $3 bln for this week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $3 bln for this week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for this week are expected to total $3 billion in 116 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $2 billion in 37 sales, with a $739 million New York City GO bond deal through Lehman Brothers topping the list.
On the competitive side, 79 sales totaling $1 billion are on the schedule. A $285 million Nevada issue on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional nine sales totaling $412 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues this week depending on market conditions.
